purpose: Detect input/label/mask/optimizer/resume failures before larger training; not research benefit
allowed_current_work: Schema/hand-authored proof rows and local validation only
corpus_generation_gate: Real ceiling/identifiability and separate generation scope not passed
coverage: ASK to distinct recipient after partial reply
private_supervision: acceptable label set + masks, never concatenated into model input

heads.whom: Public candidate index; masked conditional loss only on ASK
heads.what: Public intent + subset of already-obtained source value IDs; loss only on ASK

set_labels: Preserve correlated acceptable tuples; do not independently combine incompatible head labels
candidate_loss: Negative log probability mass of acceptable joint tuples under masked conditional heads
candidate_loss_status: Design only, not implemented model objective or proven superior
probabilities: No fabricated behavior probability; these SFT/reference rows are NOT offline RL data
fit_gate: All finite train-only proof states select an acceptable legal tuple
Per-head and conditional ASK recall/whom accuracy/what exact-source match are exported per state
Loss and parameter changes are finite/nonzero; no unauthorized frozen-parameter updates
Save/load and interrupted resume reproduce deterministic evaluation logits/actions
No train/dev/test overlap by frozen family/organization and no test filtering
Model/runtime/context/resource binding recorded before claiming an actual fit
failure_policy: Debug train-only interface or label ambiguity; do not tune on a sealed final test
